disputed.kb_f: Quick Cast keyboard default is listed as 'F' by hollowknight.wiki (official-style wiki, first fetch) but as 'E' by hollowknight.wiki.fextralife.com/Controls. Both are reputable control-listing pages and disagree, so I did not assign either as authoritative for the keyboard Quick Cast key. The Xbox equivalent (right_bumper) was consistent across both sources.
disputed.kb_e: See kb_f note — same Quick Cast keybind conflict (E vs F) between the two wiki sources checked.

source.note: Primary source read directly; cross-checked against https://hollowknight.wiki.fextralife.com/Controls, which agreed on all bindings except the keyboard Quick Cast key (E vs F), noted in 'disputed'. Hollow Knight has no default mouse bindings — keyboard+mouse play uses only keyboard by default. The Fandom wiki page (hollowknight.fandom.com/wiki/Controls_(Hollow_Knight)) could not be fetched (HTTP 402).
